entries.title: Psalms 32:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David. Maschil.>> Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.

entries.title: Psalms 32:2
segments: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.

entries.title: Psalms 32:3
segments: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away Through my groaning all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 32:4
segments: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture was changed [as] with the drought of summer. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 32:5
segments: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity did I not hide: I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 32:6
segments: For this let every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely when the great waters overflow they shall not reach unto him.

entries.title: Psalms 32:7
segments: Thou art my hiding-place; thou wilt preserve me from trouble; Thou wilt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 32:8
segments: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.

entries.title: Psalms 32:9
segments: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose trappings must be bit and bridle to hold them in, [Else] they will not come near unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 32:10
segments: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked; But he that trusteth in Jehovah, lovingkindness shall compass him about.

entries.title: Psalms 32:11
segments: Be glad in Jehovah, and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
